captions.detailed: This object is a C-clamp portable vise featuring a thick, matte black C-shaped frame with an integrated fixed upper jaw pad. A screw-driven lower jaw pad, colored light gray with textured grip lines, is positioned directly opposite the upper jaw. At the bottom, a black cylindrical screw shaft extends downward, terminating in a T-handle with spherical ends. The screw assembly is designed to rotate continuously to drive the lower jaw pad prismatically along the vertical axis of the clamp.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a C-clamp portable vise with a black C-shaped body, a fixed upper jaw pad, and a movable screw-driven lower jaw pad. The lower jaw should have a prismatic joint to slide vertically, and the T-handle screw should have a continuous rotational joint.
captions.factory: Construct the C-clamp body by combining a thick rectangular box with a smaller subtracted inner box to form the C-shape, adding a reinforced back rib and a cylindrical collar at the bottom. Model the upper jaw pad as a textured gray box attached to the upper clamp tip. Create the screw assembly using concentric cylinders for the main screw rod, a small cylinder and sphere for the T-handle, and a cylindrical gray pad with grooved details for the clamping surface. Define a prismatic joint for the vertical movement of the screw assembly relative to the frame, and a continuous joint for the rotation of the screw handle.
